data.text: In my distress I called to the LORD, and he answered me.
data.titulo: A Cry for Deliverance from Deceit

data.text: LORD, deliver my life from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.
What will he give you, and what more will he add to you, deceitful tongue?
A warrior’s sharpened arrows, with burning coals of broom wood.
Woe to me, for I sojourn in Meshech; I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
data.titulo: Living among People Who Hate Peace

data.text: Too long have I lived with those who hate peace.
I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
